stage1.impression: A plausible long, warm room with good bones (fir ceiling, banquette, counter, stools), but it reads as a well-lit CG walkthrough: grey faceless mannequin figures smeared semi-transparent, a marble-veined floor brighter than everything at eye level and cut by hard triangular shadows, four identical table vignettes with blown cool-white Orbs, and the 'centrepiece' globe reads as a black wire cage, not smoked cast acrylic. The EARF pair on the altar is tiny, dim and shows only blown white batts. As it stands it reads as a generic, slightly showroom bar; it would not run as a specific place.

blocking_9: Altar speakers legible as the hero at a glance: region [510,335,700,440] lum_median >= 45 without the white batts clipping, the smoked tint and acrylic edges visible
Mother EARF reads as thick smoked acrylic with glowing polished disc edges, not a dark wire cage (region [610,0,880,280] lum_p95 >= 70)
Floor no longer the brightest large surface and no marble veining; floor median below the counter front and banquette pools
People read as people in a long exposure (solid bodies, dark clothing, only the moving parts blurred), not grey translucent clay figures
Table vignettes varied; Orbs read as warm smoked lamps, not blown cool-white discs
Concrete wall warm grey under 2700 K, not magenta-cool; Mother EARF's shadow legible on it

defects.what: Altar speakers small and dark (lum_median 22-25), only the white batts/woofer read, blown to p95 ~230; no smoked tint, no acrylic edge glow
Mother EARF reads as a black wire/rattan cage (lum_median 8, p95 37); no acrylic thickness, no edge glow, no see-through smoke
Floor reads as polished veined marble, lum_median 71 (brightest large area), with hard dark triangular shadow shapes that read as floating cut-outs
Figures are grey, faceless and semi-transparent all over (ghosted, not motion-blurred); read as clay mannequins
Seated figures likewise grey clay; banquette figure arm smeared through the table
Four identical table vignettes (same Orb, same rocks glass placement) in a row: repeated copies
Orb reads as a flat cool-white disc (RGB 195/200/200, median 199), not a smoked lamp with a frosted liner
Concrete wall cool/magenta (r59 g49 b51) and flat; Mother EARF's shadow only two ambiguous pale crescents; no tie holes or formwork grain legible
Zinc counter top reads as pale grey stone slab (lum_median 127), brighter than the room's pools
Ceiling beams saturated orange (r88 g45 b30) and evenly lit; competes with the floor plane and pulls the eye up
Banquette foreground crushed-ish and featureless (median 18); frosted screens not legible

changes.problem: The hero, EARF's altar pair, is the dimmest thing at the end of the room and only its white batts read.

evidence.measured: lum_median 22.4 / 24.9, p95 232 / 221, clip 0.94% on the left speaker

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (W/m2 at the target) and the altar 2 x spot
change.from: area 1.0 W/m2; altar 110 W, cone 16 deg
change.to: area 3.0 W/m2 (grazing the cabinet faces and edges); altar 140 W, cone 22 deg aimed at the cabinets' shoulders rather than the batts

changes.expected: Cabinets read as smoked acrylic with glowing edges; speaker region median ~45-55 and the batts below clipping.

changes.problem: Mother EARF, the centrepiece, reads as a dark wire cage instead of thick smoked acrylic.

change.to: 130 W, cone 24 deg, moved behind/above the globe (e.g. [6.8, 0.6, 3.3]) so it rakes through the discs toward camera and lights their polished edges, still throwing the shadow on the concrete wall

changes.expected: Disc edges glow, the smoke reads see-through with the room behind it; globe p95 ~80-120; a legible disc shadow on the wall.

changes.problem: The floor is the brightest large surface and reads as veined marble with floating shadow cut-outs.

evidence.measured: lum_median 71.2 vs frame median 37; visible marble veining at 2x

change.to: darker honed concrete (tone -35%), roughness up to ~0.55, veining texture off; aim the Domes' downlights onto the table tops not the aisle

changes.expected: Floor falls to a dim floor plane with soft pools under tables; floor median ~35-50.

changes.problem: People read as grey translucent clay figures rather than guests in a long exposure.

evidence.measured: seen: uniform grey bodies, transparent through bar and shelving along their whole height

change.from: shutter 1.0 frame, head travel [0.16, 0.09, 0.03] m, turn 30 deg
change.to: shutter 0.5 frame, head travel [0.06, 0.04, 0.02] m, turn 12 deg; only head and hands move, torsos static; dark varied clothing (black, navy, oxblood), one figure fewer at the counter

changes.expected: Solid seated bodies with soft-blurred heads and hands; faces still never sharp; no see-through torsos.

changes.problem: The Orbs read as blown, cool-white flat discs, not smoked lamps with a frosted liner.
changes.expected: Orbs read warm amber-grey through the smoke with a visible liner; median ~120-160, r_median > b_median.

changes.problem: The concrete wall is cool-magenta, not warm grey under 2700 K light.
changes.expected: Concrete warm-neutral grey, b_median at or below g_median.

changes.problem: Four table vignettes in a row are identical copies, which says render.

evidence.measured: seen: same Orb, same rocks glass position on each table

change.to: vary per table: one empty with a folded napkin, one with a coupe and a menu, one with two rocks and a record sleeve, nearest with a half-drunk coupe and a phone face down; rotate each Orb 15-40 deg

changes.expected: No two tables alike; reads lived-in.

changes.problem: The zinc counter top reads as a pale grey stone slab and the fir ceiling as a saturated orange field; both outshine the pools of light.

evidence.measured: counter lum_median 127; ceiling [0,0,600,120] r 88 g 45 b 30, median 53

change.setting: the zinc's patina and the fir's stain
change.to: darker oiled zinc patina (albedo -30%, soft uneven sheen); fir stain -15% saturation, -10% value

changes.expected: Counter median ~80-100 with pools under the Domes; ceiling recedes to dark warm brown.

out_of_scope.request: Bring the altar pair closer or larger in frame so the hero reads at a glance
out_of_scope.why: Needs a camera move (no pixel test) or a change to the room's layout, which the card fixes; consider a tighter lens (35 mm) as a separate camera variant

out_of_scope.request: Speakers' white batts are the only legible part and fight the smoked tint
out_of_scope.why: The batts and cabinet are EARF's fixed product; only light can address it (c1)

out_of_scope.request: Frosted screens on the banquette are not legible from this angle
out_of_scope.why: Screens are fixed design; would need a camera change
